cases.summary: Builds a mobile-ready form that passes the firm spacing, color, and mobile rules and reports only exceptions.
cases.setup: Disposable Vite + Tailwind project outside active skill trees with an empty account settings route. Automatic discovery with ui-rules and its sibling design skills installed; paired no-skill baseline on the identical prompt, fixture, provider, model, thinking level, tools, and permissions. A headless browser is available for rendered checks.
cases.prompt: Build the account settings screen: name, email, phone, a newsletter toggle, a Save button and a Delete account button. Validate the email and phone fields.
expectedBehavior: Inputs render 16px text and use type=email and type=tel for email and phone.
Every control has a tap target of at least 44x44 and no action depends on hover.
Save is the only accent-colored button unless the reply states why another needs it; Delete account uses the danger meaning, not the accent, and is visually separated.
Validation errors show a text message, not only a red border.
Each label sits closer to its own field than to the field above, and spacing between groups exceeds spacing within a group.
The reply lists only exceptions: (default) rules broken on purpose with a reason, and rules not checked.
forbiddenBehavior: Uses more than one accent color for actions without stating a reason, or gives Delete account the accent color.
Reports a contrast or tap-target check as passing without measuring it.
Pastes the full rule checklist into the reply.

cases.summary: Builds a metrics dashboard that leads with one number, gives every number a period and change, and picks honest chart forms.
cases.setup: Disposable HTML project with a JSON fixture of monthly revenue for 12 months, revenue split across 6 product lines for September and October, and a table of 10 customers with September and October revenue. Automatic discovery; paired no-skill baseline under identical controls.
cases.prompt: Make a revenue dashboard from data.json for the October business review.
expectedBehavior: Every displayed metric states its period and its change, such as October revenue versus September.
Every bar axis starts at zero, and numeric table columns are right-aligned.

Leads with one number, shows the 6-part product split as a sorted bar chart rather than a pie, and highlights one line in any multi-line chart, unless the reply names the (default) rule it broke and why.
forbiddenBehavior: Uses a pie or donut chart for the 6 product lines without stating a reason.
Starts a bar axis above zero.
Shows a bare number with no period or comparison.

cases.summary: Lets a project design system override (default) rules but flags firm-rule conflicts and unchecked rules instead of hiding them.
cases.setup: Disposable project whose tokens file defines a 4/8/12/20 spacing scale, a centered hero layout, and a primary button of white text on #F5C518. No browser is available; only source files can be inspected. Explicit invocation of ui-rules is recorded as bypassing discovery.
cases.prompt: Add a pricing section to the landing page using our existing design tokens.
expectedBehavior: Uses the project's 12 and 20 spacing steps and centered hero, naming the (default) rules it breaks and the design-system reason.
Computes the white-on-#F5C518 contrast, finds it below 4.5:1, and flags or fixes it rather than shipping it silently.
States which rules could not be checked without a rendered page instead of marking them passed.
forbiddenBehavior: Replaces the project's spacing scale with 4/8/16/24/32.
Ships the failing button contrast without mentioning it.
Claims a visual or rendered check that did not run.
